AUTH.ADMIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This platform is for client companies. The Monkey team signs in through Monkey Admin.

LAYOUT.TAGLINE: Monkey is a GRC platform for managing risk, regulatory compliance and audits. Get each service ready for its audit, control by control.
LAYOUT.THEME: Switch between light and dark theme

LOGIN.TITLE: Sign in
LOGIN.ACTIVATE_WITH_KEY: Activate my account with a code
LOGIN.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not sign you in. Check your email and password.

REGISTER.TITLE: Activate your account
REGISTER.CODE_HELP: Enter the code you got by email. It works only once.
REGISTER.FIXED_HELP: Whoever gave you the code set these details and they cannot be changed. You only need to create your password.
REGISTER.EMAIL_ALWAYS: You will always sign in with this email.
REGISTER.ERROR_LOOKUP: We could not check the code. Try again.
REGISTER.ERROR_ACTIVATE: We could not activate your account. Try again.

MFA.QR_REVEAL: Click to show the QR code
MFA.QR_REVEAL_HINT: For security, it is only shown when you ask for it.
MFA.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not verify the code. Enter the one your app shows now.
MFA.VERIFY_HELP: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for Monkey. It changes every 30 seconds.
MFA.RECOVERY_HELP: Enter one of the codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each code works only once.
MFA.SETUP_INTRO: A code only you see on your phone protects your account.
MFA.INSTALL_BODY: You need an app that generates codes on your phone.
MFA.INSTALL_EXAMPLES: Any works, for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or 1Password.
MFA.SCAN_HELP: In the app, choose “Add account” and point the camera at this code.
MFA.QR_ALT: QR code to add Monkey to your authenticator app
MFA.MANUAL_HELP: Can't scan? Type this key into the app by hand:
MFA.CONFIRM_HELP: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
MFA.CODES_HELP: If you lose or change your phone, each of these codes lets you in once. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
MFA.SAVED: I saved my codes somewhere safe
MFA.CODES_FILE_HEADER: Monkey recovery codes. Each one works only once. Keep them somewhere safe and do not share them.
MFA.REMEMBER_HELP: On this browser we will ask only for your password.

FORGOT.TITLE: Recover your password
FORGOT.HELP: Enter your account email. If it exists, we will send you a link to create a new password.
FORGOT.SENT_BODY: If the account exists, we sent you a link to create a new password. It works once and expires in 30 minutes. To finish we will ask for the code from your authenticator app.
FORGOT.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not send the link. Try again in a few minutes.

RESET.TITLE: Create your new password
RESET.HELP: Choose a new password and confirm it is you with the code from your authenticator app.
RESET.DONE_BODY: We signed out all your sessions. Sign in with your new password.
RESET.INVALID_BODY: The link expired, was already used or is not correct. Request a new one and use it within 30 minutes.
RESET.ERROR_FALLBACK: We could not change the password. Try again.
